item.title: JavaScript Optional Chaining and Nullish Coalescing Usage and Alternatives
item.description:
“JavaScript Optional Chaining and Nullish Coalescing Usage and Alternatives”

How can developers safely access nested object properties or call optional functions in JavaScript without triggering runtime errors when intermediate properties are null or undefined? The modern ECMAScript specification (ES2020) introduced powerful operators for this, but older methods still hold relevance.

Modern Approach: Optional Chaining (?.) and Nullish Coalescing (??)

Since ES2020, the Optional Chaining operator (?.) permits safe traversal through chained properties or functions. If any link in the chain is null or undefined, the expression immediately short-circuits and returns undefined.
